verdict.rationale: Bento gives agents programmatic access through an official MCP server, a CLI with 50+ commands, and an API. Audiences are covered: subscriber lookup with filters by tags, segments and date ranges, and tag/field management. Broadcast history can be reviewed via the API, but there is no evidence that agents can read live workflows or sequences, or pull per-campaign performance metrics such as opens, clicks or attributed revenue. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to live automation (workflow/sequence) state, campaign performance stats via API, a documented reporting workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
